headline: Council Approves Longer Lunch After Lengthy Debate
dek: The measure passed 7–2 after councillors agreed that existing lunch periods were no longer meeting modern requirements.
excerpt: New Zork City Council voted Thursday to extend its official lunch period by fourteen minutes.

body.text: NEW ZORK — City Council voted Thursday evening to extend its official lunch period by fourteen minutes, concluding several months of consultation, committee review and increasingly hungry public hearings.
Supporters argued that the previous lunch period placed unreasonable pressure on councillors attempting to purchase food, eat it and complain about municipal parking within the allotted time.
Fourteen minutes is not radical. Fourteen minutes is responsible governance.
Opponents questioned whether the additional time would improve productivity or simply extend the period during which nobody answered email.
The new lunch schedule takes effect Monday. A formal review is expected next year, assuming nobody forgets.
